adjudicated_statement: Work over C with rational singular cohomology and its mixed Hodge structure. For g>=2, let pi_i:M_{g,n}->M_{g,n-1} forget the ith marking, define Phi_{g,n}^k=sum_i pi_i^*W_k H^k(M_{g,n-1};Q), and define Psi_{g,n}^k=sum_i psi_i Phi_{g,n}^{k-2}. Canning-Larson-Payne Lemma 3.1(a) gives an isomorphism of pure rational Hodge structures W_k H^k(M_{g,n};Q)/(Phi_{g,n}^k+Psi_{g,n}^k) isomorphic to the direct sum over partitions lambda with |lambda|=n and length(lambda)<=g of W_k H^{k-n}(M_g;mathbb V_lambda) tensor V_{lambda^T}, where mathbb V_lambda is the weight-|lambda| rational symplectic local system and V_{lambda^T} is the corresponding rational S_n-module with trivial Hodge structure. At (g,n,k)=(6,6,26), every underlying group H^20(M_6;mathbb V_lambda) vanishes: stack cohomology identifies it with H^20(Mod_6;mathbb V_lambda), and a torsion-free normal finite-index subgroup of Mod_6 has cohomological dimension vcd(Mod_6)=4*6-5=19; Hochschild-Serre for the finite quotient is exact over Q. Consequently W_26 H^26(M_{6,6};Q)/(Phi_{6,6}^26+Psi_{6,6}^26)=0 as a pure rational Hodge structure. This conclusion concerns only the primitive quotient and does not infer vanishing at degree 26 from vcd(Mod_{6,6})=26.
contradiction_resolution: The mandatory origin check found that ATT-0135, CLM-0135-1 and CLM-0135-2 use the published primitive-quotient formula, while REV-0185 identifies three possible attacks: applicability of vcd to nontrivial symplectic coefficients, the W_26 indexing on degree-20 local-system cohomology, and the informal psi-versus-R^2 projector sketch. The final published Canning-Larson-Payne article resolves the latter two directly: Lemma 3.1(a) states the quotient is the direct sum of W_k H^{k-n}(M_g;mathbb V_lambda) tensor V_{lambda^T}, and its proof uses the closed universal curve, smooth-proper Leray degeneration, the all-R^1 Kunneth term, Petersen-Tavakol-Yin projectors, and symplectic contractions. Thus (g,n,k)=(6,6,26) gives ordinary degree 20 and weight index 26; it does not involve the mixed R^1 of the punctured forgetful map discussed in FND-0037. Church-Farb-Putman explicitly record Harer's result vcd(Mod_g)=4g-5 and the consequent vanishing H^i(Mod_g;V tensor Q)=0 for i>4g-5 and arbitrary Mod_g-modules V. Formally, choose a torsion-free normal finite-index subgroup Gamma of Mod_6 with cd(Gamma)=19. Then H^20(Gamma;mathbb V_lambda)=0, and Hochschild-Serre for the finite quotient Mod_6/Gamma collapses over Q because finite-group invariants are exact, giving H^20(Mod_6;mathbb V_lambda)=0. Hence W_26 of that zero group is zero. This is compatible with FND-0035: FND-0035 only blocks an above-vcd argument at the target degree 26 on Mod_{6,6}, whereas the present application is degree 20>19 on Mod_6. It also does not contradict RED-0001, THM-0005, or any claim listed in contradicts_claim_ids. No equivalent adjudicated finding was found, so merging is unwarranted. The finding is promoted only for the primitive quotient; ATT-0135's later conclusions still require its separate Phi-vanishing and CKgP/Tate inputs.
